quarterly_data.signal: Linde's 10-Q: capital expenditures for the six months ended June 30, 2026 were $2,780 million, $253 million higher than the prior year, primarily for new plant and production equipment for backlog growth requirements. Linde estimates the consideration related to future minimum purchase requirements (company-wide, under on-site customers' long-term supply arrangements) and plant sales from the Linde Engineering business at approximately $64 billion as of June 30, 2026; the amount excludes all on-site sales above minimum purchase requirements.
quarterly_data.figure: six-month capex $2,780 million (+$253 million); future minimum purchase requirements and plant sales approximately $64 billion (June 30, 2026)
